notes.title: Update: Emails Received
notes.notes:
[h1]Attention Vikings and Shield Maidens[/h1]

The email you had received to come play, then once clicked on given an error. This email was sent in error by steam. We apologize for this inconvenience and excitement. We are working diligently to bring you an awesome playtest. We would also like to extend our deepest thanks to everyone who is excited for Pantheon Rift. We are building this game for all of you. With out or team or you all, we wouldn't be where we are currently. 

Keep a lookout for out event updates! Don't forget to join our discord located on the main steam page! 

Regards,
Kyrie Studios Team
